propositions: caused_by links currently accept any target without validating that the target has a referencing commit, allowing misattributed dependency edges
rebar link must refuse caused_by edges to targets with no referencing commits, with a --force escape hatch available on CLI, library, and MCP
the commit scan logic from close_precheck must be hoisted into commit_impact.py as a single shared implementation called by both link validation and close precheck
a caused_by link should only require the resolved target itself to have a referencing commit, not its descendants, to prevent hierarchy-promoted misattribution
unverifiable targets (no code repo or no git history) must allow the link; only targets provably commit-less should refuse
dry-run preview must show the refusal identically to the actual link command
